AWS Free Tier FAQs

Q5. When do Free Tier credits expire?

Free Tier credits expire 12 months from the date you create your AWS account. You can view the credit expiration date in the Credits page in the AWS Billing and Cost Management Console.

Q7. Is there any reason I would be ineligible for free plan or Free Tier credits?

You would be ineligible for free plan or Free Tier credits if you have an existing AWS account or have had one in the past. The free plan and Free Tier credits are available only to new AWS customers.

Q9. What happens if I exceed the free usage limits of always-free services?

If you exceed the free usage limits, your account will begin incurring charges at the standard pay-as-you-go service rates (see each service page for full pricing details). Your Free Tier credits will automatically apply to these charges. If your account is under the free plan, you won’t see any charges on your AWS Bills. If your account is under a paid plan, you’ll simply pay for charges that exceed your Free Tier credit balance.

Q10. Am I required to provide a payment method to sign up for an AWS account?

Yes, you are required to provide a valid payment method to sign up for an AWS account, whether you choose a free plan or a paid plan.

Free Plan Accounts

Q1. Why should I choose the free plan?

The free plan allows you to experiment with AWS services and build proof-of-concepts at no cost for up to 6 months until you upgrade to a paid plan.

Q3. When does my free plan expire?

Your free plan expires the earlier of (1) 6-months from the date you opened your AWS account, or (2) once you have exhausted your Free Tier credits.

Q5. What happens when my free plan expires?

When your free plan expires, AWS closes your account, and you’ll lose access to your resources and data. AWS will retain your data for 90 days after your free plan expires. During this period, you have the option to upgrade to paid plan to reopen your account and restore access to your resources. If you don’t upgrade your account within 90 days, AWS will permanently erase your AWS account and all its content.

Q12. Why do I need to provide payment method to sign up for free plan?

AWS requires a valid payment method to verify your identity and prevent abuse of AWS resources. AWS will not charge your payment method until you upgrade to paid plan, and you will not need to reenter your payment method when you upgrade.
